questions.content: A label says Co and another says CO. Explain why their meanings differ.
questions.answerKey: Co is the element cobalt; CO is carbon monoxide, a compound of carbon and oxygen.
questions.markingGuide: Check letter case and whether one or two elements are represented. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A pure substance has particles containing one nitrogen and three hydrogen atoms. Write its formula and total atoms per molecule.
questions.answerKey: NH₃; four atoms per molecule.
questions.markingGuide: Use element symbols and a subscript for three hydrogen atoms. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Explain why dissolving salt in water is different from forming a new compound.
questions.answerKey: The components remain a mixture and can be separated physically; a new compound involves chemical joining in a fixed ratio.
questions.markingGuide: Compare mixture formation with chemical combination. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Count atoms of each element in 4CO₂.
questions.answerKey: Four carbon atoms and eight oxygen atoms.
questions.markingGuide: Multiply every formula count by the coefficient. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A learner puts sodium in a group because of the first letter of its name. Explain the error.
questions.answerKey: Periodic-table position is based on atomic structure and atomic number, not alphabetical order.
questions.markingGuide: Do not confuse a table group with a naming convention. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: An atom has 19 protons, 20 neutrons and 19 electrons. Give Z, A and its shell arrangement.
questions.answerKey: Z=19, A=39; arrangement 2,8,8,1.
questions.markingGuide: Count protons for Z and add protons and neutrons for A. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A neutral atom has arrangement 2,8,6. State its electron number and period.
questions.answerKey: 16 electrons; period 3.
questions.markingGuide: Add shell populations and count occupied shells. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A magnesium atom loses two electrons. What are its charge and electron arrangement?
questions.answerKey: Mg²⁺ with arrangement 2,8.
questions.markingGuide: The neutral atom starts with 12 electrons. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Compare chlorine-35 and chlorine-37, both with Z=17.
questions.answerKey: Both have 17 protons; they have 18 and 20 neutrons respectively.
questions.markingGuide: Changing neutrons makes isotopes, not a different element. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A student states that every atom has equal proton and neutron numbers. Give a counterexample.
questions.answerKey: Sodium-23 has 11 protons and 12 neutrons.
questions.markingGuide: One valid atom with unequal counts disproves the universal claim. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A 50 N force moves a trolley 8 m in the force direction in 10 s. Find work and average power.
questions.answerKey: Work=400 J; power=40 W.
questions.markingGuide: Use W=Fs, then P=W/t. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A foot exerts 300 N on 0.015 m². Find the pressure.
questions.markingGuide: Divide normal force by area in m². 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A machine receives 800 J and delivers 200 J useful work. Find efficiency and non-useful energy transfer.
questions.answerKey: 25%; 600 J transferred in other ways.
questions.markingGuide: Useful/input ×100%, then subtract useful from input. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Two pupils push a box in opposite directions with equal 40 N forces. Describe the resultant and what it does not tell you.
questions.answerKey: Resultant is zero; it does not by itself tell whether the box is stationary or moving at constant velocity.
questions.markingGuide: Distinguish force balance from state of motion. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Explain why using a larger supporting area can protect soft ground from a heavy load.
questions.answerKey: The same normal force distributed over a larger area gives lower pressure.
questions.markingGuide: Connect the area change to F/A. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A ray makes 18° with a plane mirror. Calculate incidence and reflection angles.
questions.answerKey: Both are 72° to the normal.
questions.markingGuide: Subtract 18° from 90°. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A student moves from 1 m to 1.5 m in front of a plane mirror. Find the change in object–image separation.
questions.answerKey: Separation changes from 2 m to 3 m, an increase of 1 m.
questions.markingGuide: Both object and virtual image distances contribute. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Explain why a glass window may both transmit light and reflect some light.
questions.answerKey: Different portions of incident light can be transmitted and reflected at its surfaces.
questions.markingGuide: Do not assume transparent means zero reflection. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A ray enters water exactly along the normal. Does the absence of bending prove its speed stays the same?
questions.answerKey: No. Its speed can change at normal incidence without a direction change.
questions.markingGuide: Separate speed change from bending. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Explain why a mirror image can appear behind an opaque wall-mounted mirror.
questions.answerKey: Reflected rays reach the eye as if originating behind the mirror; the image is virtual.
questions.markingGuide: No physical object or real ray convergence is required behind it. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A plant is supplied with more light but its rate stays unchanged. Give two possible limiting factors.
questions.answerKey: Carbon dioxide availability or temperature; water supply can also limit it.
questions.markingGuide: More light need not overcome a different shortage. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Explain a connection between stomata and the risk of water loss.
questions.answerKey: Open stomata allow carbon dioxide entry but also permit water vapour to leave.
questions.markingGuide: Show the trade-off between gas exchange and water conservation. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: An iodine result is brown rather than blue-black. What can be concluded, and what cannot?
questions.answerKey: Starch was not detected under the test conditions; this alone does not prove the plant has never photosynthesised.
questions.markingGuide: Distinguish a specific observation from a broad claim. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Design a paper-based comparison to investigate the need for light without doing laboratory work.
questions.answerKey: Compare supplied starch-test observations from otherwise similar leaves with illuminated and covered regions, checking controls and prior starch conditions.
questions.markingGuide: State the changed factor, controls and evidence to compare. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Explain why nitrates and magnesium cannot replace sunlight in photosynthesis.
questions.answerKey: They support plant structure and chlorophyll/protein production but do not supply the light energy used by the process.
questions.markingGuide: Distinguish nutrients from energy input. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A learner describes bile as a protein-digesting enzyme. Correct both parts.
questions.answerKey: Bile is not an enzyme; it emulsifies fats and helps neutralise acid. Proteases digest protein.
questions.markingGuide: Correct the identity and function. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Explain why diarrhoea or damaged intestine can affect nutrition even when food is eaten.
questions.answerKey: Food intake does not guarantee effective absorption of water and nutrients; intestinal function matters.
questions.markingGuide: This is a conceptual answer, not a diagnosis. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Compare the roles of teeth and amylase when eating starchy food.
questions.answerKey: Teeth mechanically break it up; amylase chemically breaks down starch.
questions.markingGuide: Mention increased surface area as a link. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Plan three headings for a report interpreting supplied food-test results.
questions.answerKey: Method/conditions, observations/results, and conclusions with limitations.
questions.markingGuide: Observed colour changes should be distinguished from nutrient conclusions. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Why is a meal rich in energy not necessarily balanced?
questions.answerKey: It may lack adequate protein, vitamins, minerals, fibre or water even if it supplies enough energy.
questions.markingGuide: Adequacy involves different nutrient roles. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Convert 0.454545… into a fraction.
questions.markingGuide: 100x−x=45, so x=45/99=5/11. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Solve −4x ≥ 20.
questions.markingGuide: Reverse the sign when dividing by −4. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Round 0.009965 to three significant figures.
questions.markingGuide: The first significant digit is 9 and the next retained digit rounds up. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Order −3/2, −1.2 and −2 from smallest to largest.
questions.markingGuide: Convert −3/2 to −1.5 or use the number line. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Estimate 49.6/0.248 using convenient rounded values, and explain why it is only an estimate.
questions.answerKey: 50/0.25≈200; rounded inputs differ from the originals.
questions.markingGuide: State the approximations used. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Solve x² + 2x − 15 = 0.
questions.markingGuide: Factor as (x+5)(x−3). 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Solve 2x² − 8 = 0.
questions.markingGuide: First obtain x²=4. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Solve x² − 6x + 2 = 0 by completing the square.
questions.markingGuide: (x−3)²=7. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Simplify (3²)³/3⁴.
questions.markingGuide: Multiply exponents inside the power, then subtract. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Multiply (2 × 10³)(4 × 10⁻⁵) and write standard form.
questions.markingGuide: Multiply coefficients and add powers of ten. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Changanua kazi za maneno katika Asha mdogo anakimbia haraka.
questions.answerKey: Asha ni nomino; mdogo kivumishi; anakimbia kitenzi; haraka kielezi.
questions.markingGuide: Kazi itegemee sentensi iliyotolewa. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Unganisha hoja hizi kwa sababu: Tulisoma maktabani. Darasa lilikuwa na kelele.
questions.answerKey: Tulisoma maktabani kwa sababu darasa lilikuwa na kelele.
questions.markingGuide: Kiunganishi kionyeshe sababu kwa usahihi. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Tunga aya ya sentensi tatu yenye kiunganishi na kielezi.
questions.answerKey: Tulipanda miti shuleni. Kisha tuliimwagilia kwa uangalifu. Tulishirikiana kwa sababu tulitaka ikue vizuri.
questions.markingGuide: Pima mpangilio, kiunganishi na kielezi katika muktadha. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Tumia yeye bila kufanya msomaji ashindwe kujua anayerejelewa.
questions.answerKey: Amina amefika. Yeye atatusaidia kupanga vitabu.
questions.markingGuide: Rejea ya kiwakilishi iwe wazi. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Hariri: je amina amemwona juma
questions.answerKey: Je, Amina amemwona Juma?
questions.markingGuide: Kagua herufi kubwa na alama ya swali. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Geuza kuwa wingi: Mti huu uliopandwa jana umeota.
questions.answerKey: Miti hii iliyopandwa jana imeota.
questions.markingGuide: Badili nomino, kionyeshi na kirejeshi kwa usahihi. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Geuza kuwa umoja: Vitabu hivi vizuri vimefika.
questions.answerKey: Kitabu hiki kizuri kimefika.
questions.markingGuide: Vipashio vinavyorejelea nomino vipatane. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Sahihisha na eleza: Watoto hawa amefika mapema.
questions.answerKey: Watoto hawa wamefika mapema; kitenzi kipatane na watoto.
questions.markingGuide: Usibadili maana bila sababu. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Tunga sentensi changamani kuhusu mwanafunzi na kitabu.
questions.answerKey: Mwanafunzi aliyekopa kitabu amekirudisha.
questions.markingGuide: Onyesha kishazi tegemezi na upatanisho sahihi. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Eleza kwa mfano kwa nini umbo la nomino pekee halionyeshi wingi kila wakati.
questions.answerKey: Nyumba imejengwa / nyumba zimejengwa: nomino hubaki ileile lakini kitenzi hubadilika.
questions.markingGuide: Husisha ushahidi na hitimisho. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: A is at 20°E and B at 50°E. If A has local solar time 08:00, find B’s.
questions.markingGuide: Difference 30° gives 2 hours; B is east and ahead. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Explain why a coordinate written only as 7° is incomplete.
questions.answerKey: It needs identification as latitude/longitude and a north/south or east/west direction, plus the other coordinate to locate a point fully.
questions.markingGuide: A number alone cannot specify a location. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Compare the causes of day/night and seasons.
questions.answerKey: Rotation causes day/night; axial tilt with revolution produces the seasonal cycle.
questions.markingGuide: Do not use Sun-distance change as the main seasonal explanation. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Calculate the ideal local-time difference for 7.5° longitude.
questions.answerKey: 30 minutes.
questions.markingGuide: 7.5 × 4 minutes per degree. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Why should an ideal longitude answer not automatically be used as a travel clock time?
questions.answerKey: Actual civil time zones and legal time rules may differ from ideal solar-time calculations.
questions.markingGuide: Identify the model’s limitation. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Explain how loss of vegetation can connect the biosphere and hydrosphere.
questions.answerKey: Fewer plants can change interception, infiltration and runoff, affecting stream flow and erosion.
questions.markingGuide: Give a process link rather than naming two systems. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Correct: The lithosphere is just another word for the crust.
questions.answerKey: It includes the crust and rigid uppermost mantle.
questions.markingGuide: Distinguish structural boundaries. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Trace one water molecule through three water-cycle stages.
questions.answerKey: It evaporates from a lake, condenses in a cloud and returns as precipitation.
questions.markingGuide: Keep stages in a physically possible sequence. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Compare the inner and outer core by state.
questions.answerKey: Inner core is solid; outer core is liquid.
questions.markingGuide: Do not infer state from temperature alone. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Give an example of a geographical model limitation.
questions.answerKey: A layered model may not use true thickness scale or show variations within each layer.
questions.markingGuide: Explain what information is simplified. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A pupil says all people who take large risks are good entrepreneurs. Evaluate the statement.
questions.answerKey: Good entrepreneurship uses research, planning and affordable tests; large unexamined risks can cause avoidable losses.
questions.markingGuide: Distinguish calculated uncertainty from reckless gambling. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Write two neutral questions to investigate demand for a bicycle repair service.
questions.answerKey: Where do you currently get repairs? What affects your choice of repairer?
questions.markingGuide: Questions should not pressure respondents into praising the idea. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A trader expects 40 sales but can survive only if at least 35 sell. Give one way to test this assumption before a large purchase.
questions.answerKey: Use a small trial or reliable customer orders and compare actual sales with the estimate.
questions.markingGuide: Tie the test to demand uncertainty. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Explain why a one-person business can be quick to decide but vulnerable to illness.
questions.answerKey: One owner can decide without consulting partners, but operations may depend on that person’s time and skills.
questions.markingGuide: Link the same ownership structure to both effects. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Total unit purchase and delivery cost is 1200 and selling price 1450. What remains before other costs?
questions.answerKey: TSh 250 per unit.
questions.markingGuide: Do not call this final profit without considering other costs. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Classify harvesting tomatoes, canning them and delivering cans to a shop.
questions.answerKey: Primary, secondary and tertiary production respectively.
questions.markingGuide: State how each activity adds usefulness. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: A loan of 80,000 requires 8 payments of 12,000 plus a 2000 fee. Find total repayment and total finance cost.
questions.answerKey: Repayment plus fee=98,000; finance cost=18,000.
questions.markingGuide: Include the fee as well as instalments. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Expected stock is 15+24−19 units. A physical count finds 18. Find expected stock and discrepancy.
questions.answerKey: Expected 20; physical stock is 2 units lower.
questions.markingGuide: Investigate rather than silently inventing a sale. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Explain why credit-funded stock creates both an opportunity and an obligation.
questions.answerKey: Goods can be sold before payment is due, but the supplier still must be paid under the terms.
questions.markingGuide: Consider cash flow and the risk of unsold goods. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Give one possible cooperative benefit and one issue to check.
questions.answerKey: Joint purchasing may reduce costs; members should check fees, obligations and governance.
questions.markingGuide: Do not assume every cooperative guarantees a benefit. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Tathmini dai: Jamii isiyo na mfalme ilikuwa haina siasa.
questions.answerKey: Dai si sahihi; mabaraza ya wazee, mifumo ya ukoo au rika ingeweza kupanga mamlaka na maamuzi.
questions.markingGuide: Tofautisha aina za uongozi. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Eleza uhusiano kati ya mazingira na aina za uzalishaji bila kutumia kauli ya watu wote.
questions.answerKey: Upatikanaji wa maji au malisho ungeathiri kilimo au ufugaji, lakini jamii ingeweza kuchanganya shughuli na kubadilika.
questions.markingGuide: Epuka kufunga watu wote katika shughuli moja. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Pendekeza ushahidi wa kuchunguza teknolojia ya chuma ya eneo fulani.
questions.answerKey: Zana, mabaki ya tanuru, muktadha wa uchimbaji na simulizi za mafundi vinaweza kulinganishwa.
questions.markingGuide: Vyanzo mbalimbali viunganishwe bila kuharibu urithi. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Eleza manufaa na athari hasi zinazoweza kuandamana na biashara ya mbali.
questions.answerKey: Kubadilishana bidhaa na maarifa kunaweza kunufaisha, lakini unyonyaji na biashara ya watumwa vilileta madhara makubwa katika baadhi ya mahusiano.
questions.markingGuide: Linganisha athari kwa makundi na vipindi tofauti. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Kwa nini usihamishe kitu cha kale kutoka mahali kilipopatikana bila rekodi?
questions.answerKey: Muktadha wake unaweza kutoa ushahidi kuhusu matumizi, uhusiano na kipindi; kuondoa kiholela hupoteza taarifa.
questions.markingGuide: Heshimu utaratibu wa utunzaji na utaalamu. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Panga: Muungano, uhuru wa Tanganyika, TANU, Mapinduzi ya Zanzibar.
questions.answerKey: TANU 1954; uhuru wa Tanganyika 1961; Mapinduzi Januari 1964; Muungano Aprili 1964.
questions.markingGuide: Tarehe na mfuatano viendane. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Linganisha upinzani wa silaha na kuondoka eneo lenye masharti ya kazi.
questions.answerKey: Mbinu hutofautiana lakini zote zinaweza kuonyesha kukataa masharti; ushahidi wa lengo na muktadha unahitajika.
questions.markingGuide: Usihukumu kukubali au kupinga kutokana na vita pekee. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Sahihisha dai: Uhuru wa Zanzibar na Mapinduzi yalikuwa tukio lilelile.
questions.answerKey: Uhuru ulikuwa 10 Desemba 1963; Mapinduzi yalikuwa 12 Januari 1964.
questions.markingGuide: Tofautisha matukio na tarehe. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Eleza kwa nini sera za kodi zinaweza kubadili maisha ya kiuchumi.
questions.answerKey: Zinaweza kuhitaji mapato ya fedha na kuathiri namna watu wanavyotumia kazi, ardhi na uzalishaji.
questions.markingGuide: Husisha sera na maamuzi ya jamii kwa ushahidi. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Pendekeza vyanzo viwili vya kuchunguza tukio la upinzani.
questions.answerKey: Nyaraka za kipindi hicho na simulizi au ushahidi wa maeneo husika, vikilinganishwa kwa muktadha.
questions.markingGuide: Chunguza mtunzi, kusudi na mapungufu ya kila chanzo. Alama 2 kwa jibu na maelezo sahihi; alama 1 kwa uelewa sahihi lakini maelezo pungufu.

questions.content: Rewrite in the negative: Asha has a bicycle.
questions.answerKey: Asha does not have a bicycle.
questions.markingGuide: Use does not + base have. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Correct both verbs: Yesterday he buy a book and readed it.
questions.answerKey: Yesterday he bought a book and read it.
questions.markingGuide: The written past form of read stays read, with different pronunciation. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Write one routine sentence and one sentence about an action happening now.
questions.answerKey: I walk to school every day. I am reading now.
questions.markingGuide: Use simple present for the routine and progressive for the present action. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Explain why an university is incorrect in ordinary English.
questions.answerKey: University begins with a consonant /j/ sound, so a university is used.
questions.markingGuide: Article choice follows sound rather than the written vowel alone. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Give a polite request for directions to a library.
questions.answerKey: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the library?
questions.markingGuide: Use a clear destination and appropriate politeness. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Give one fact and one inference from the Halima passage, labeling them.
questions.answerKey: Fact: she had a borrowed dictionary. Inference: revision was a priority for her that morning.
questions.markingGuide: Separate stated evidence from a reasoned conclusion. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Evaluate: Halima had never been to a market in her life.
questions.answerKey: Unsupported. Her response on one morning does not establish her lifelong behaviour.
questions.markingGuide: Identify the overgeneralisation. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Summarise the passage in no more than twenty words.
questions.answerKey: Halima revised early at the library, followed her timetable and compared science answers with a friend.
questions.markingGuide: Keep main actions without unsupported additions. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Combine with a result connector: They revised together. They identified different answers to discuss.
questions.answerKey: They revised together; therefore, they identified different answers to discuss.
questions.markingGuide: Accept a coherent result link; avoid reversing cause and effect. 2 marks for a correct response with required reasoning; 1 for a correct key idea with incomplete reasoning.

questions.content: Paraphrase: Several seats were already occupied.
questions.answerKey: Other learners were already using a number of seats.

questions.content: A muddy salt solution is filtered. Predict what is in the filtrate.

questions.content: Name a separation method when the solvent must also be collected.
